source.description:
IAA Frankfurt 2019

Undoubtedly the most anticipated debut at the otherwise disappointing Frankfurt Motor Show 2019, with many brands not attending, was the all-electric Volkswagen ID.3. Replacing the e-Golf, VW is aiming high with the ID.3, which should be both affordable (European pricing between € 30,000 and € 50,000 depending on accu capacity and trim level) and has impressive specs and electric range. It comes in three battery pack configurations: the Pure (45 kWh), Pro (58 kWh) and Pro S (77 kWh).
